title: Compute u,v via lattice energy minimization
action: Implement the lattice energy model: point-charge Madelung sum (Bertaut method with Templeton convergence correction) plus short-range repulsion terms 1/r^m for M-O and 1/r^n for V-O. Use the provided lattice parameters and Model II repulsion constants. For each vanadate compound (YVO4, NdVO4, ErVO4, and the lanthanide series CeVO4 through LuVO4), numerically minimize the total energy with respect to the oxygen fractional coordinates u,v in Wyckoff site 16(h) (space group I41/amd). Write the minimizing u,v for every compound to predicted_positions.csv.
description: Minimizes lattice energy for each compound and writes predicted oxygen parameters.
